title: Score Submission Planner
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Compare your SAT or ACT score with every college on your list and get a college-by-college recommendation on whether to submit it, with the reason shown.

learningObjectives: Students will decide, college by college, whether to submit a test score by comparing it with each college's middle 50% range and policy, and justify each decision.
prerequisites: Chapter 6: The SAT and ACT Question

controls: Add college, Remove selected, and Load Emily's list buttons
Try a retest score button and slider
Row editor: name, policy, 25th, 75th, merit cutoff, inflated-range checkbox

keyQuestions: Why make the submission decision college by college instead of once for your whole list?
When does a merit-scholarship cutoff override the range comparison?
Why might a test-optional college's published range overstate typical scores?
commonMisconceptions: Test-optional means scores no longer matter.
You should send your score everywhere or nowhere.
assessmentOpportunities: Students justify a submit, don't-submit, or judgment-call decision for three colleges using the score's position against each range.
